title: Pure Sylvan
summary: Pure Sylvan Plant control and Xyz strategy focused on excavating cards from the top of the Deck and triggering powerful bonus effects whenever Plant monsters are sent to the GY by excavation. Stacking the top of the Deck with Mount Sylvania and Sylvan Charity turns random excavations into guaranteed monster removal, swarming, and deck spinning.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mount Sylvania sends a Plant monster from hand or face-up field to the GY to place 1 Sylvan card from your Deck on top of the Deck once per turn, and excavates the top card during the opponent's End Phase.
Sylvan Charity draws 3 cards, then places 2 cards from your hand on top of the Deck in any order, including at least 1 Sylvan card.
Sylvan Marshalleaf excavates up to 2 cards on Normal Summon, and destroys 1 monster on the field when excavated and sent to the GY.
Sylvan Hermitree excavates the top card of your Deck once per turn and draws 1 card if it was a Plant, and looks at and stacks the top 3 cards of your Deck when excavated.
Sylvan Cherubsprout excavates up to 2 cards on Special Summon, and Special Summons a Level 1 Plant from your Deck when excavated.

summary.title: Opening: Mount Sylvania + Any Plant
steps: Activate Mount Sylvania and use its effect to send a Plant from your hand to the GY to stack Sylvan Marshalleaf or Sylvan Cherubsprout on top of your Deck.
Normal Summon Sylvan Marshalleaf or Sylvan Peaskeeper, excavating the stacked Plant to trigger its GY effect.
Trigger Cherubsprout or Peaskeeper to Special Summon a Plant from your Deck or GY, fielding two Plants.
Link Summon Sylvan Dancepione using 2 Plants, and activate its effect to excavate up to 3 cards and Special Summon up to 2 excavated Plant monsters.
Overlay your high-Level Plants for Alsei, the Sylvan High Protector or Orea, the Sylvan High Arbiter.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Alsei, the Sylvan High Protector declares 1 card name once per turn to excavate the top card, adding it to hand if called correctly; when a card is sent from your Deck to the GY by card effect, detaches 1 material to spin 1 card on the field to the top or bottom of the Deck.
Orea, the Sylvan High Arbiter excavates up to 3 Plant monsters to return that many cards on the field to the hand without targeting, and looks at and stacks cards on top of the Deck.
Sylvan Dancepione excavates up to 3 cards on Link Summon to Special Summon up to 2 excavated Plants with different Levels, and modulates Plant Levels from the GY.
Teardrop the Rikka Queen detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to tribute 1 monster on either field.
Benghalancer the Resurgent provides Link-4 bounce disruption by returning an opponent's Special Summoned monster to the hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mount Sylvania acts as the central engine, manipulating the top card of your Deck to guarantee optimal excavation outcomes.
Sylvan Charity provides unmatched hand sculpting and topdeck manipulation by drawing 3 cards and placing key Sylvans on top.
Sylvan Blessing places a Sylvan monster from your hand or GY on top or bottom of the Deck to Special Summon a Sylvan monster from your hand or GY immune to card effects.
